structs.notes: Residuals in the packet are artifacts. The packet puts m_response at 62808 (-40 / +16 residuals); the constructor stores bdSerializedStringRecord at 62824 (the game-test offset), and m_outstandingTaskId is identity at 79272, so the members between are unchanged. The entire shift is inside m_lobbyData (lobby -6424 from the 6424-byte additional-slots list that Replay does not build), which moves every later member by -6424. The size proposal depends on the lobby child (92400) and on the exact size of m_qos (unconfirmed). Player list node offsets used for the evidence are the Player fields in the game-test layout (Player 0xB0 team, 0xB4 squad, 0xC0 performance, 0xA4/0xA8 statuses, 0x60 bIsLocal).
